text: This section does not limit the court's power to control leading questions.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "2", "part": "2.1", "division": "5", "subdivision": null, "section": "42", "subsection": "4", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Leading question is defined in the Dictionary.

heading: Prior inconsistent statements of witnesses
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "2", "part": "2.1", "division": "5", "subdivision": null, "section": "43", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": "2", "part": "2.1", "division": "5", "subdivision": null, "section": "43", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: A witness may be cross-examined about a prior inconsistent statement alleged to have been made by the witness whether or not—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "2", "part": "2.1", "division": "5", "subdivision": null, "section": "43", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: complete particulars of the statement have been given to the witness; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "2", "part": "2.1", "division": "5", "subdivision": null, "section": "43", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: a document containing a record of the statement has been shown to the witness.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "2", "part": "2.1", "division": "5", "subdivision": null, "section": "43", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: If, in cross-examination, a witness does not admit that he or she has made a prior inconsistent statement, the cross-examiner is not to adduce evidence of the statement otherwise than from the witness unless, in the cross-examination, the cross-examiner—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "2", "part": "2.1", "division": "5", "subdivision": null, "section": "43", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: informed the witness of enough of the circumstances of the making of the statement to enable the witness to identify the statement; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "2", "part": "2.1", "division": "5", "subdivision": null, "section": "43", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: drew the witness's attention to so much of the statement as is inconsistent with the witness's evidence.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "2", "part": "2.1", "division": "5", "subdivision": null, "section": "43", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: For the purpose of adducing evidence of the statement, a party may re-open the party's case.

heading: Previous representations of other persons
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "2", "part": "2.1", "division": "5", "subdivision": null, "section": "44", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": "2", "part": "2.1", "division": "5", "subdivision": null, "section": "44", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Except as provided by this section, a cross-examiner must not question a witness about a previous representation alleged to have been made by a person other than the witness.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "2", "part": "2.1", "division": "5", "subdivision": null, "section": "44", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: A cross-examiner may question a witness about the representation and its contents if—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "2", "part": "2.1", "division": "5", "subdivision": null, "section": "44", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: evidence of the representation has been admitted; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "2", "part": "2.1", "division": "5", "subdivision": null, "section": "44", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the court is satisfied that it will be admitted.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "2", "part": "2.1", "division": "5", "subdivision": null, "section": "44", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: If subsection (2) does not apply and the representation is contained in a document, the document may only be used to question a witness as follows—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "2", "part": "2.1", "division": "5", "subdivision": null, "section": "44", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the document must be produced to the witness;

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "2", "part": "2.1", "division": "5", "subdivision": null, "section": "44", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: if the document is a tape recording, or any other kind of document from which sounds are reproduced—the witness must be provided with the means (for example, headphones) to listen to the contents of the document without other persons present at the cross-examination hearing those contents;

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "2", "part": "2.1", "division": "5", "subdivision": null, "section": "44", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": "c", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the witness must be asked whether, having examined (or heard) the contents of the document, the witness stands by the evidence that he or she has given;

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "2", "part": "2.1", "division": "5", "subdivision": null, "section": "44", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": "d", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: neither the cross-examiner nor the witness is to identify the document or disclose any of its contents.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "2", "part": "2.1", "division": "5", "subdivision": null, "section": "44", "subsection": "4", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: A document that is so used may be marked for identification.

heading: Production of documents
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "2", "part": "2.1", "division": "5", "subdivision": null, "section": "45", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": "2", "part": "2.1", "division": "5", "subdivision": null, "section": "45", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: This section applies if a party is cross-examining or has cross-examined a witness about—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "2", "part": "2.1", "division": "5", "subdivision": null, "section": "45", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: a prior inconsistent statement alleged to have been made by the witness that is recorded in a document; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "2", "part": "2.1", "division": "5", "subdivision": null, "section": "45", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: a previous representation alleged to have been made by another person that is recorded in a document.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "2", "part": "2.1", "division": "5", "subdivision": null, "section": "45", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: If the court so orders or if another party so requires, the party must produce—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "2", "part": "2.1", "division": "5", "subdivision": null, "section": "45", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the document; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "2", "part": "2.1", "division": "5", "subdivision": null, "section": "45", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: such evidence of the contents of the document as is available to the party—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "2", "part": "2.1", "division": "5", "subdivision": null, "section": "45", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: to the court or to that other party.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "2", "part": "2.1", "division": "5", "subdivision": null, "section": "45", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: The court may—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "2", "part": "2.1", "division": "5", "subdivision": null, "section": "45", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: examine a document or evidence that has been so produced; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "2", "part": "2.1", "division": "5", "subdivision": null, "section": "45", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: give directions as to its use; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "2", "part": "2.1", "division": "5", "subdivision": null, "section": "45", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": "c", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: admit it even if it has not been tendered by a party.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "2", "part": "2.1", "division": "5", "subdivision": null, "section": "45", "subsection": "4", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Subsection (3) does not permit the court to admit a document or evidence that is not admissible because of Chapter 3.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "2", "part": "2.1", "division": "5", "subdivision": null, "section": "45", "subsection": "5", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: The mere production of a document to a witness who is being cross-examined does not give rise to a requirement that the cross-examiner tender the document.

heading: Leave to recall witnesses
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "2", "part": "2.1", "division": "5", "subdivision": null, "section": "46", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": "2", "part": "2.1", "division": "5", "subdivision": null, "section": "46", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: The court may give leave to a party to recall a witness to give evidence about a matter raised by evidence adduced by another party, being a matter on which the witness was not cross-examined, if the evidence concerned has been admitted and—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "2", "part": "2.1", "division": "5", "subdivision": null, "section": "46", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: it contradicts evidence about the matter given by the witness in examination in chief; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "2", "part": "2.1", "division": "5", "subdivision": null, "section": "46", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the witness could have given evidence about the matter in examination in chief.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "2", "part": "2.1", "division": "5", "subdivision": null, "section": "46", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: A reference in this section to a matter raised by evidence adduced by another party includes a reference to an inference drawn from, or that the party intends to draw from, that evidence.

heading: Documents
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "2", "part": "2.2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": null, "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

heading: Definitions
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "2", "part": "2.2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "47", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": "2", "part": "2.2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "47", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: A reference in this Part to a document in question is a reference to a document as to the contents of which it is sought to adduce evidence.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "2", "part": "2.2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "47", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: A reference in this Part to a copy of a document in question includes a reference to a document that is not an exact copy of the document in question but that is identical to the document in question in all relevant respects.

heading: Proof of contents of documents
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "2", "part": "2.2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "48", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": "2", "part": "2.2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "48", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: A party may adduce evidence of the contents of a document in question by tendering the document in question or by any one or more of the following methods—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "2", "part": "2.2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "48", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: adducing evidence of an admission made by another party to the proceeding as to the contents of the document in question;

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "2", "part": "2.2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "48", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: tendering a document that—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "2", "part": "2.2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "48", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": "i", "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: is or purports to be a copy of the document in question; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "2", "part": "2.2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "48", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": "ii", "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: has been produced, or purports to have been produced, by a device that reproduces the contents of documents;

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "2", "part": "2.2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "48", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "c", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: if the document in question is an article or thing by which words are recorded in such a way as to be capable of being reproduced as sound, or in which words are recorded in a code (including shorthand writing)— tendering a document that is or purports to be a transcript of the words;

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "2", "part": "2.2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "48", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "d", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: if the document in question is an article or thing on or in which information is stored in such a way that it cannot be used by the court unless a device is used to retrieve, produce or collate it—tendering a document that was or purports to have been produced by use of the device;

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "2", "part": "2.2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "48", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "e", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: tendering a document that—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "2", "part": "2.2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "48", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "e", "subparagraph": "i", "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: forms part of the records of or kept by a business (whether or not the business is still in existence); and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "2", "part": "2.2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "48", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "e", "subparagraph": "ii", "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: is or purports to be a copy of, or an extract from or a summary of, the document in question, or is or purports to be a copy of such an extract or summary;

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "2", "part": "2.2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "48", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "f", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: if the document in question is a public document—tendering a document that is or purports to be a copy of the document in question and that is or purports to have been printed—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "2", "part": "2.2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "48", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "f", "subparagraph": "i", "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: by a person authorised by or on behalf of the Government to print the document or by the Government Printer of the Commonwealth or by the government or official printer of another State or a Territory; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "2", "part": "2.2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "48", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "f", "subparagraph": "ii", "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: by the authority of the Government or administration of the State, the Commonwealth, another State, a Territory or a foreign country; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "2", "part": "2.2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "48", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "f", "subparagraph": "iii", "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: by authority of an Australian Parliament, a House of an Australian Parliament, a committee of such a House or a committee of an Australian Parliament.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "2", "part": "2.2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "48", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Subsection (1) applies to a document in question whether the document in question is available to the party or not.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "2", "part": "2.2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "48", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: If the party adduces evidence of the contents of a document under subsection (1)(a), the evidence may only be used—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "2", "part": "2.2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "48", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: in respect of the party's case against the other party who made the admission concerned; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "2", "part": "2.2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "48", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: in respect of the other party's case against the party who adduced the evidence in that way.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "2", "part": "2.2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "48", "subsection": "4", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: A party may adduce evidence of the contents of a document in question that is not available to the party, or the existence and contents of which are not in issue in the proceeding, by—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "2", "part": "2.2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "48", "subsection": "4", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: tendering a document that is a copy of, or an extract from or summary of, the document in question; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "2", "part": "2.2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "48", "subsection": "4", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: adducing from a witness evidence of the contents of the document in question.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "2", "part": "2.2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "48", "subsection": "4", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Clause 5 of Part 2 of the Dictionary is about the availability of documents.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "2", "part": "2.2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "48", "subsection": "4", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Section 182 of the Commonwealth Act gives section 48 of the Commonwealth Act a wider application in relation to Commonwealth records and certain Commonwealth documents.

heading: Documents in foreign countries
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "2", "part": "2.2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "49", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: No paragraph of section 48(1) (other than paragraph (a)) applies to a document that is in a foreign country unless—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "2", "part": "2.2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "49", "subsection": null, "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the party who adduces evidence of the contents of the document in question has, not less than 28 days (or such other period as may be prescribed by the regulations or by rules of court) before the day on which the evidence is adduced, served on each other party a copy of the document proposed to be tendered; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "2", "part": "2.2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "49", "subsection": null, "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the court directs that it is to apply.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "2", "part": "2.2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "49", "subsection": null, "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Section 182 of the Commonwealth Act gives section 49 of the Commonwealth Act a wider application in relation to Commonwealth records and certain Commonwealth documents.

heading: Proof of voluminous or complex documents
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "2", "part": "2.2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "50", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": "2", "part": "2.2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "50", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: The court may, on the application of a party, direct that the party may adduce evidence of the contents of 2 or more documents in question in the form of a summary if the court is satisfied that it would not otherwise be possible conveniently to examine the evidence because of the volume or complexity of the documents in question.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "2", "part": "2.2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "50", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: The court may only make such a direction if the party seeking to adduce the evidence in the form of a summary has—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "2", "part": "2.2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "50", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: served on each other party a copy of the summary that discloses the name and address of the person who prepared the summary; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "2", "part": "2.2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "50", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: given each other party a reasonable opportunity to examine or copy the documents in question.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "2", "part": "2.2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "50", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: The opinion rule does not apply to evidence adduced in accordance with a direction under this section.

heading: Original document rule abolished
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "2", "part": "2.2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "51", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: The principles and rules of the common law that relate to the means of proving the contents of documents are abolished.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "2", "part": "2.2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "51", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Section 182 of the Commonwealth Act gives the provisions of Part 2.2 of the Commonwealth Act a wider application in relation to Commonwealth records and certain Commonwealth documents.

heading: Other evidence
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "2", "part": "2.3", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": null, "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

heading: Adducing of other evidence not affected
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "2", "part": "2.3", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "52", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: This Act (other than this Part) does not affect the operation of any Australian law or rule of practice so far as it permits evidence to be adduced in a way other than by witnesses giving evidence or documents being tendered in evidence.

heading: Views
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "2", "part": "2.3", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "53", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": "2", "part": "2.3", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "53", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: A judge may, on application, order that a demonstration, experiment or inspection be held.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "2", "part": "2.3", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "53", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: A judge is not to make an order unless he or she is satisfied that—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "2", "part": "2.3", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "53", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the parties will be given a reasonable opportunity to be present; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "2", "part": "2.3", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "53", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the judge and, if there is a jury, the jury will be present.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "2", "part": "2.3", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "53", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Without limiting the matters that the judge may take into account in deciding whether to make an order, the judge is to take into account the following—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "2", "part": "2.3", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "53", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: whether the parties will be present;

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "2", "part": "2.3", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "53", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: whether the demonstration, experiment or inspection will, in the court's opinion, assist the court in resolving issues of fact or understanding the evidence;

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "2", "part": "2.3", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "53", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": "c", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the danger that the demonstration, experiment or inspection might be unfairly prejudicial, might be misleading or confusing or might cause or result in undue waste of time;

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "2", "part": "2.3", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "53", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": "d", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: in the case of a demonstration—the extent to which the demonstration will properly reproduce the conduct or event to be demonstrated;

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "2", "part": "2.3", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "53", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": "e", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: in the case of an inspection—the extent to which the place or thing to be inspected has materially altered.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "2", "part": "2.3", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "53", "subsection": "4", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: The court (including, if there is a jury, the jury) is not to conduct an experiment in the course of its deliberations.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "2", "part": "2.3", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "53", "subsection": "5", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: This section does not apply in relation to the inspection of an exhibit by the court or, if there is a jury, by the jury.

heading: Views to be evidence
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "2", "part": "2.3", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "54", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: The court (including, if there is a jury, the jury) may draw any reasonable inference from what it sees, hears or otherwise notices during a demonstration, experiment or inspection.

heading: Admissibility of evidence Introductory Note
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": null, "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": null, "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Outline of this Chapter This Chapter is about whether evidence adduced in a proceeding is admissible. Part 3.1 sets out the general inclusionary rule that relevant evidence is admissible. Part 3.2 is about the exclusion of hearsay evidence, and exceptions to the hearsay rule. Part 3.3 is about exclusion of opinion evidence, and exceptions to the opinion rule. Part 3.4 is about admissions and the extent to which they are admissible as exceptions to the hearsay rule and the opinion rule. Part 3.5 is about exclusion of certain evidence of judgments and convictions. Part 3.6 is about exclusion of evidence of tendency or coincidence, and exceptions to the tendency rule and the coincidence rule. Part 3.7 is about exclusion of evidence relevant only to credibility, and exceptions to the credibility rule. Part 3.8 is about character evidence and the extent to which it is admissible as exceptions to the hearsay rule, the opinion rule, the tendency rule and the credibility rule. Part 3.9 is about the requirements that must be satisfied before identification evidence is admissible. Part 3.10 is about the various categories of privilege that may prevent evidence being adduced. Part 3.11 provides for the discretionary and mandatory exclusion of evidence even if it would otherwise be admissible. The following diagram shows how this Chapter applies to particular evidence—

heading: Relevance
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.1", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": null, "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

heading: Relevant evidence
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.1", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "55", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.1", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "55", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: The evidence that is relevant in a proceeding is evidence that, if it were accepted, could rationally affect (directly or indirectly) the assessment of the probability of the existence of a fact in issue in the proceeding.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.1", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "55", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: In particular, evidence is not taken to be irrelevant only because it relates only to—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.1", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "55", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the credibility of a witness; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.1", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "55", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the admissibility of other evidence; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.1", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "55", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "c", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: a failure to adduce evidence.

heading: Relevant evidence to be admissible
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.1", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "56", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.1", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "56", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Except as otherwise provided by this Act, evidence that is relevant in a proceeding is admissible in the proceeding.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.1", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "56", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Evidence that is not relevant in the proceeding is not admissible.

heading: Provisional relevance
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.1", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "57", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.1", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "57", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: If the determination of the question whether evidence adduced by a party is relevant depends on the court making another finding (including a finding that the evidence is what the party claims it to be), the court may find that the evidence is relevant—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.1", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "57", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: if it is reasonably open to make that finding; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.1", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "57", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: subject to further evidence being admitted at a later stage of the proceeding that will make it reasonably open to make that finding.

history_json: [{"raw": "S. 57(2) amended by No. 63/2014 s. 7(12).", "kind": "amendment", "section": "57", "sub_path": ["(2)"], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 50, "rect": {"page": 50, "x0": 79.3, "y0": 163.6, "x1": 123.1, "y1": 202.7}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.1", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "57", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Without limiting subsection (1), if the relevance of evidence of an act done by a person depends on the court making a finding that the person and one or more other persons had, or were acting in furtherance of, a common purpose (whether to effect an unlawful conspiracy or as part of involvement in the commission of an offence or otherwise), the court may use the evidence itself in determining whether the common purpose existed.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.1", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "57", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Subsection (2) differs from section 57(2) of the Commonwealth Act and New South Wales Act.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.1", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "57", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Subdivision (1) of Division 1 of Part II of the Crimes Act 1958 deals with complicity in commission of offences.

heading: Inferences as to relevance
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.1", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "58", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.1", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "58", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: If a question arises as to the relevance of a document or thing, the court may examine it and may draw any reasonable inference from it, including an inference as to its authenticity or identity.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.1", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "58", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.10", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "117", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": "client"}

text: the person for whom it was prepared—

heading: The hearsay rule
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": null, "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

heading: The hearsay rule—exclusion of hearsay evidence
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "59", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "59", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Evidence of a previous representation made by a person is not admissible to prove the existence of a fact that it can reasonably be supposed that the person intended to assert by the representation.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "59", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Such a fact is in this Part referred to as an asserted fact.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "59", "subsection": "2A", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: For the purposes of determining under subsection (1) whether it can reasonably be supposed that the person intended to assert a particular fact by the representation, the court may have regard to the circumstances in which the representation was made.

history_json: [{"raw": "Examples to s. 59 amended by No. 68/2009 s. 97(Sch. item 55.10).", "kind": "amendment", "section": "59", "sub_path": [], "target_kind": "example", "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 52, "rect": {"page": 52, "x0": 79.3, "y0": 456.4, "x1": 123.2, "y1": 513.9}, "confidence": "low"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "59", "subsection": "2A", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: D is the accused in a sexual assault trial. W has made a statement to the police that X told W that X had seen D leave a night club with the victim shortly before the sexual assault is alleged to have occurred. Unless an exception to the hearsay rule applies, evidence of what X told W cannot be given at the trial.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "59", "subsection": "2A", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: P had told W that the handbrake on W's car did not work. Unless an exception to the hearsay rule applies, evidence of that statement cannot be given by P, W or anyone else to prove that the handbrake was defective.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "59", "subsection": "2A", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: W had bought a video cassette recorder and written down its serial number on a document. Unless an exception to the hearsay rule applies, the document is inadmissible to prove that a video cassette recorder later found in D's possession was the video cassette recorder bought by W.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "59", "subsection": "2A", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: The Commonwealth Act and New South Wales Act include another subsection.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "59", "subsection": "2A", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text:
Specific exceptions to the hearsay rule are as follows—
• evidence relevant for a non-hearsay purpose (section 60)
• first-hand hearsay—
• civil proceedings, if the maker of the representation is unavailable (section 63) or available (section 64)
• criminal proceedings, if the maker of the representation is unavailable (section 65) or available (section 66)
• contemporaneous statements about a person's health etc. (section 66A)
• business records (section 69)
• tags and labels (section 70)
• electronic communications (section 71)
• Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander traditional laws and customs (section 72)
• marriage, family history or family relationships (section 73)
• public or general rights (section 74)
• use of evidence in interlocutory proceedings (section 75)
• admissions (section 81)
• representations about employment or authority (section 87(2))
• exceptions to the rule excluding evidence of judgments and convictions (section 92(3))
• character of and expert opinion about an accused (sections 110 and 111). Other provisions of this Act, or of other laws, may operate as further exceptions.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "59", "subsection": "2A", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Subsection (2A) was inserted as a response to the decision of the Supreme Court of New South Wales in R v Hannes (2000) 158 FLR 359.

heading: Exception—evidence relevant for a non-hearsay purpose
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "60", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "60", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: The hearsay rule does not apply to evidence of a previous representation that is admitted because it is relevant for a purpose other than proof of an asserted fact.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "60", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: This section applies whether or not the person who made the representation had personal knowledge of the asserted fact (within the meaning of section 62(2)).

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "60", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Subsection (2) was inserted as a response to the decision of the High Court of Australia in Lee v The Queen (1998) 195 CLR 594.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "60", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: However, this section does not apply in a criminal proceeding to evidence of an admission.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "60", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: The admission might still be admissible under section 81 as an exception to the hearsay rule if it is "first-hand" hearsay—see section 82.

heading: Exceptions to the hearsay rule dependant on competency
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "61", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "61", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: This Part does not enable use of a previous representation to prove the existence of an asserted fact if, when the representation was made, the person who made it was not competent to give evidence about the fact because of section 13(1).

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "61", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: This section does not apply to a contemporaneous representation made by a person about his or her health, feelings, sensations, intention, knowledge or state of mind.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "61", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: For the admissibility of such contemporaneous representations, see section 66A.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "61", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: For the purposes of this section, it is presumed, unless the contrary is proved, that when the representation was made the person who made it was competent to give evidence about the asserted fact.

heading: "First-hand" hearsay
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": null, "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

heading: Restriction to "first-hand" hearsay
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "62", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "62", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: A reference in this Division (other than in subsection (2)) to a previous representation is a reference to a previous representation that was made by a person who had personal knowledge of an asserted fact.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "62", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: A person has personal knowledge of the asserted fact if his or her knowledge of the fact was, or might reasonably be supposed to have been, based on something that the person saw, heard or otherwise perceived, other than a previous representation made by another person about the fact.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "62", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: For the purposes of section 66A, a person has personal knowledge of the asserted fact if it is a fact about the person's health, feelings, sensations, intention, knowledge or state of mind at the time the representation referred to in that section was made.

heading: Exception—civil proceedings if maker not available
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "63", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "63", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: This section applies in a civil proceeding if a person who made a previous representation is not available to give evidence about an asserted fact.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "63", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: The hearsay rule does not apply to—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "63", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: evidence of the representation that is given by a person who saw, heard or otherwise perceived the representation being made; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "63", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: a document so far as it contains the representation, or another representation to which it is reasonably necessary to refer in order to understand the representation.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "63", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Section 67 imposes notice requirements relating to this subsection.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "63", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Clause 4 of Part 2 of the Dictionary is about the availability of persons.

heading: Exception—civil proceedings if maker available
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "64", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "64", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: This section applies in a civil proceeding if a person who made a previous representation is available to give evidence about an asserted fact.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "64", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: The hearsay rule does not apply to—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "64", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: evidence of the representation that is given by a person who saw, heard or otherwise perceived the representation being made; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "64", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: a document so far as it contains the representation, or another representation to which it is reasonably necessary to refer in order to understand the representation—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "64", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: if it would cause undue expense or undue delay, or would not be reasonably practicable, to call the person who made the representation to give evidence.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "64", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Section 67 imposes notice requirements relating to this subsection. Section 68 is about objections to notices that relate to this subsection.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "64", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: If the person who made the representation has been or is to be called to give evidence, the hearsay rule does not apply to evidence of the representation that is given by—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "64", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: that person; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "64", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: a person who saw, heard or otherwise perceived the representation being made.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "64", "subsection": "4", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: A document containing a representation to which subsection (3) applies must not be tendered before the conclusion of the examination in chief of the person who made the representation, unless the court gives leave.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "64", "subsection": "4", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Clause 4 of Part 2 of the Dictionary is about the availability of persons.

heading: Exception—criminal proceedings if maker not available
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "65", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "65", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: This section applies in a criminal proceeding if a person who made a previous representation is not available to give evidence about an asserted fact.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "65", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: The hearsay rule does not apply to evidence of a previous representation that is given by a person who saw, heard or otherwise perceived the representation being made, if the representation—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "65", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: was made under a duty to make that representation or to make representations of that kind; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "65", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: was made when or shortly after the asserted fact occurred and in circumstances that make it unlikely that the representation is a fabrication; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "65", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "c", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: was made in circumstances that make it highly probable that the representation is reliable; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "65", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "d", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: was—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "65", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "d", "subparagraph": "i", "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: against the interests of the person who made it at the time it was made; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "65", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "d", "subparagraph": "ii", "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: made in circumstances that make it likely that the representation is reliable.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "65", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "d", "subparagraph": "ii", "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Section 67 imposes notice requirements relating to this subsection.

history_json: [{"raw": "S. 65(3) amended by No. 68/2009 s. 97(Sch. item 55.11).", "kind": "amendment", "section": "65", "sub_path": ["(3)"], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 57, "rect": {"page": 57, "x0": 467.8, "y0": 291.0, "x1": 511.5, "y1": 339.4}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "65", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: The hearsay rule does not apply to evidence of a previous representation made in the course of giving evidence in an Australian or overseas proceeding if, in that proceeding, the accused in the proceeding to which this section is being applied—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "65", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: cross-examined the person who made the representation about it; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "65", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: had a reasonable opportunity to cross-examine the person who made the representation about it.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "65", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Section 67 imposes notice requirements relating to this subsection.

history_json: [{"raw": "S. 65(4) amended by No. 68/2009 s. 97(Sch. item 55.12).", "kind": "amendment", "section": "65", "sub_path": ["(4)"], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 57, "rect": {"page": 57, "x0": 467.8, "y0": 507.4, "x1": 511.5, "y1": 555.6}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "65", "subsection": "4", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: If there is more than one accused in the criminal proceeding, evidence of a previous representation that—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "65", "subsection": "4", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: is given in an Australian or overseas proceeding; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "65", "subsection": "4", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: is admitted into evidence in the criminal proceeding because of subsection (3)—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "65", "subsection": "4", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: cannot be used against an accused who did not cross-examine, and did not have a reasonable opportunity to cross-examine, the person about the representation.

history_json: [{"raw": "S. 65(5) amended by No. 68/2009 s. 97(Sch. item 55.13).", "kind": "amendment", "section": "65", "sub_path": ["(5)"], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 58, "rect": {"page": 58, "x0": 79.3, "y0": 163.6, "x1": 123.1, "y1": 211.9}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "65", "subsection": "5", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: For the purposes of subsections (3) and (4), an accused is taken to have had a reasonable opportunity to cross-examine a person if the accused was not present at a time when the cross-examination of a person might have been conducted but—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "65", "subsection": "5", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: could reasonably have been present at that time; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "65", "subsection": "5", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: if present could have cross-examined the person.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "65", "subsection": "6", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Evidence of the making of a representation to which subsection (3) applies may be adduced by producing a transcript, or a recording, of the representation that is authenticated by—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "65", "subsection": "6", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the person to whom, or the court or other body to which, the representation was made; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "65", "subsection": "6", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: if applicable, the registrar or other proper officer of the court or other body to which the representation was made; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "65", "subsection": "6", "paragraph": "c", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the person or body responsible for producing the transcript or recording.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "65", "subsection": "7", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Without limiting subsection (2)(d), a representation is taken for the purposes of that subsection to be against the interests of the person who made it if it tends—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "65", "subsection": "7", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: to damage the person's reputation; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "65", "subsection": "7", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: to show that the person has committed an offence for which the person has not been convicted; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "65", "subsection": "7", "paragraph": "c", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: to show that the person is liable in an action for damages.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "65", "subsection": "8", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: The hearsay rule does not apply to—

history_json: [{"raw": "S. 65(8)(a) amended by No. 68/2009 s. 97(Sch. item 55.14).", "kind": "amendment", "section": "65", "sub_path": ["(8)", "(a)"], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 59, "rect": {"page": 59, "x0": 467.8, "y0": 177.4, "x1": 511.5, "y1": 225.7}, "confidence": "high"}]

text: Section 67 imposes notice requirements relating to this subsection.

history_json: [{"raw": "S. 65(9) amended by No. 68/2009 s. 97(Sch. item 55.15).", "kind": "amendment", "section": "65", "sub_path": ["(9)"], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 59, "rect": {"page": 59, "x0": 467.8, "y0": 373.8, "x1": 511.5, "y1": 422.2}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "65", "subsection": "9", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "66", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

text: Subsection (2) differs from the Commonwealth Act and New South Wales Act.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "66", "subsection": "2A", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: In determining whether the occurrence of the asserted fact was fresh in the memory of a person, the court may take into account all matters that it considers are relevant to the question, including—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "66", "subsection": "2A", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the nature of the event concerned; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "66", "subsection": "2A", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the age and health of the person; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "66", "subsection": "2A", "paragraph": "c", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the period of time between the occurrence of the asserted fact and the making of the representation.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "66", "subsection": "2A", "paragraph": "c", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Subsection (2A) was inserted as a response to the decision of the High Court of Australia in Graham v The Queen (1998) 195 CLR 606.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "66", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: If a representation was made for the purpose of indicating the evidence that the person who made it would be able to give in an Australian or overseas proceeding, subsection (2) does not apply to evidence adduced by the prosecutor of the representation unless the representation concerns the identity of a person, place or thing.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "66", "subsection": "4", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: A document containing a representation to which subsection (2) applies must not be tendered before the conclusion of the examination in chief of the person who made the representation, unless the court gives leave.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "66", "subsection": "4", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Clause 4 of Part 2 of the Dictionary is about the availability of persons.

heading: Exception—contemporaneous statements about a person's health etc.
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "66A", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: The hearsay rule does not apply to evidence of a previous representation made by a person if the representation was a contemporaneous representation about the person's health, feelings, sensations, intention, knowledge or state of mind.

heading: Notice to be given
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "67", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "67", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Sections 63(2), 64(2) and 65(2), (3) and (8) do not apply to evidence adduced by a party unless that party has given reasonable notice in writing to each other party of the party's intention to adduce the evidence.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "67", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Notices given under subsection (1) are to be given in accordance with any regulations or rules of court made for the purposes of this section.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "67", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: The notice must state—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "67", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the particular provisions of this Division on which the party intends to rely in arguing that the hearsay rule does not apply to the evidence; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "67", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: if section 64(2) is such a provision—the grounds, specified in that provision, on which the party intends to rely.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "67", "subsection": "4", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Despite subsection (1), if notice has not been given, the court may, on the application of a party, direct that one or more of those subsections is to apply despite the party's failure to give notice.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "67", "subsection": "5", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: The direction—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "67", "subsection": "5", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: is subject to such conditions (if any) as the court thinks fit; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "67", "subsection": "5", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: in particular, may provide that, in relation to specified evidence, the subsection or subsections concerned apply with such modifications as the court specifies.

heading: Objections to tender of hearsay evidence in civil proceedings if maker available
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "68", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "68", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: In a civil proceeding, if the notice discloses that it is not intended to call the person who made the previous representation concerned because it—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "68", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: would cause undue expense or undue delay; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "68", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: would not be reasonably practicable—
