path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "68", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: a party may, not later than 21 days after notice has been given, object to the tender of the evidence, or of a specified part of the evidence.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "68", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: The objection is to be made by giving to each other party a written notice setting out the grounds on which the objection is made.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "68", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: The court may, on the application of a party, determine the objection at or before the hearing.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "68", "subsection": "4", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: If the objection is unreasonable, the court may order that, in any event, the party objecting is to bear the costs incurred by another party—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "68", "subsection": "4", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: in relation to the objection; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "68", "subsection": "4", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: in calling the person who made the representation to give evidence.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "68", "subsection": "4", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: This subsection differs from section 68(4) of the Commonwealth Act because of the different way costs are ascertained by Victorian courts.

heading: Other exceptions to the hearsay rule
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": null, "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

heading: Exception—business records
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": "69", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": "69", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: This section applies to a document that—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": "69", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: either—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": "69", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": "i", "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: is or forms part of the records belonging to or kept by a person, body or organisation in the course of, or for the purposes of, a business; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": "69", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": "ii", "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: at any time was or formed part of such a record; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": "69", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: contains a previous representation made or recorded in the document in the course of, or for the purposes of, the business.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": "69", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: The hearsay rule does not apply to the document (so far as it contains the representation) if the representation was made—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": "69", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: by a person who had or might reasonably be supposed to have had personal knowledge of the asserted fact; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": "69", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: on the basis of information directly or indirectly supplied by a person who had or might reasonably be supposed to have had personal knowledge of the asserted fact.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": "69", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Subsection (2) does not apply if the representation—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": "69", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: was prepared or obtained for the purpose of conducting, or for or in contemplation of or in connection with, an Australian or overseas proceeding; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": "69", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: was made in connection with an investigation relating or leading to a criminal proceeding.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": "69", "subsection": "4", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: If—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": "69", "subsection": "4", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the occurrence of an event of a particular kind is in question; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": "69", "subsection": "4", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: in the course of a business, a system has been followed of making and keeping a record of the occurrence of all events of that kind—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": "69", "subsection": "4", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the hearsay rule does not apply to evidence that tends to prove that there is no record kept, in accordance with that system, of the occurrence of the event.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": "69", "subsection": "5", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: For the purposes of this section, a person is taken to have had personal knowledge of a fact if the person's knowledge of the fact was or might reasonably be supposed to have been based on what the person saw, heard or otherwise perceived (other than a previous representation made by a person about the fact).

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": "69", "subsection": "5", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Sections 48, 49, 50, 146, 147 and 150(1) are relevant to the mode of proof, and authentication, of business records.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": "69", "subsection": "5", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Section 182 of the Commonwealth Act gives section 69 of the Commonwealth Act a wider application in relation to Commonwealth records.

heading: Exception—contents of tags, labels and writing
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": "70", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: The hearsay rule does not apply to a tag or label attached to, or writing placed on, an object (including a document) if the tag or label or writing may reasonably be supposed to have been so attached or placed—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": "70", "subsection": null, "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: in the course of a business; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": "70", "subsection": null, "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: for the purpose of describing or stating the identity, nature, ownership, destination, origin or weight of the object, or of the contents (if any) of the object.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": "70", "subsection": null, "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: The Commonwealth Act has an additional subsection. It provides that the exception does not apply to Customs and Excise prosecutions. Section 5 of the Commonwealth Act extends the application of that subsection to proceedings in all Australian courts.

heading: Exception—electronic communications
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": "71", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: The hearsay rule does not apply to a representation contained in a document recording an electronic communication so far as the representation is a representation as to—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": "71", "subsection": null, "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the identity of the person from whom or on whose behalf the communication was sent; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": "71", "subsection": null, "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the date on which or the time at which the communication was sent; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": "71", "subsection": null, "paragraph": "c", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the destination of the communication or the identity of the person to whom the communication was addressed.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": "71", "subsection": null, "paragraph": "c", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Division 3 of Part 4.3 contains presumptions about electronic communications.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": "71", "subsection": null, "paragraph": "c", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Section 182 of the Commonwealth Act gives section 71 of the Commonwealth Act a wider application in relation to Commonwealth records.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": "71", "subsection": null, "paragraph": "c", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Electronic communication is defined in the Dictionary.

heading: Exception—Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander traditional laws and customs
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": "72", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: The hearsay rule does not apply to evidence of a representation about the existence or non-existence, or the content, of the traditional laws and customs of an Aboriginal or Torres Strait Islander group.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": "72", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Section 72 formerly provided an exception for contemporaneous statements about a person's health etc. Such provision can now be found in section 66A.

heading: Exception—reputation as to relationships and age
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": "73", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": "73", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: The hearsay rule does not apply to evidence of reputation concerning—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": "73", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: whether a person was, at a particular time or at any time, a married person; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": "73", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: whether a man and a woman cohabiting at a particular time were married to each other at that time; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": "73", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "c", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: a person's age; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": "73", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "d", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: family history or a family relationship.

history_json: [{"raw": "S. 73(2) amended by No. 68/2009 s. 97(Sch. item 55.16(a)).", "kind": "amendment", "section": "73", "sub_path": ["(2)"], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 66, "rect": {"page": 66, "x0": 79.3, "y0": 556.1, "x1": 127.4, "y1": 604.5}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": "73", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: In a criminal proceeding, subsection (1) does not apply to evidence adduced by an accused unless—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": "73", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: it tends to contradict evidence of a kind referred to in subsection (1) that has been admitted; or

history_json: [{"raw": "S. 73(2)(b) amended by No. 68/2009 s. 97(Sch. item 55.16 (b)(c)).", "kind": "amendment", "section": "73", "sub_path": ["(2)", "(b)"], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 66, "rect": {"page": 66, "x0": 79.3, "y0": 637.1, "x1": 123.1, "y1": 694.7}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": "73", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the accused has given reasonable notice in writing to each other party of the intention of the accused to adduce the evidence.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": "73", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: In a criminal proceeding, subsection (1) does not apply to evidence adduced by the prosecutor unless it tends to contradict evidence of a kind referred to in subsection (1) that has been admitted.

heading: Exception—reputation of public or general rights
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": "74", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": "74", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: The hearsay rule does not apply to evidence of reputation concerning the existence, nature or extent of a public or general right.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": "74", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: In a criminal proceeding, subsection (1) does not apply to evidence adduced by the prosecutor unless it tends to contradict evidence of a kind referred to in subsection (1) that has been admitted.

heading: Exception—interlocutory proceedings
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.2", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": "75", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: In an interlocutory proceeding, the hearsay rule does not apply to evidence if the party who adduces it also adduces evidence of its source.

heading: Opinion
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.3", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": null, "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

heading: The opinion rule
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.3", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "76", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Evidence of an opinion is not admissible to prove the existence of a fact about the existence of which the opinion was expressed.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.3", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "76", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: P sues D, her doctor, for the negligent performance of a surgical operation. Unless an exception to the opinion rule applies, P's neighbour, W, who had the same operation, cannot give evidence of his opinion that D had not performed the operation as well as his own.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.3", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "76", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: P considers that electrical work that D, an electrician, has done for her is unsatisfactory. Unless an exception to the opinion rule applies, P cannot give evidence of her opinion that D does not have the necessary skills to do electrical work.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.3", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "76", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: The Commonwealth Act and New South Wales Act include an additional subsection.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.3", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "76", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text:
Specific exceptions to the opinion rule are as follows—
• summaries of voluminous or complex documents (section 50(3))
• evidence relevant otherwise than as opinion evidence (section 77)
• lay opinion (section 78)
• Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander traditional laws and customs (section 78A)
• expert opinion (section 79)
• admissions (section 81)
• exceptions to the rule excluding evidence of judgments and convictions (section 92(3))
• character of and expert opinion about an accused (sections 110 and 111). Other provisions of this Act, or of other laws, may operate as further exceptions.

heading: Exception—evidence relevant otherwise than as opinion evidence
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.3", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "77", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: The opinion rule does not apply to evidence of an opinion that is admitted because it is relevant for a purpose other than proof of the existence of a fact about the existence of which the opinion was expressed.

heading: Exception—lay opinions
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.3", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "78", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: The opinion rule does not apply to evidence of an opinion expressed by a person if—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.3", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "78", "subsection": null, "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the opinion is based on what the person saw, heard or otherwise perceived about a matter or event; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.3", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "78", "subsection": null, "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: evidence of the opinion is necessary to obtain an adequate account or understanding of the person's perception of the matter or event.

heading: Exception—Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander traditional laws and customs
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.3", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "78A", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: The opinion rule does not apply to evidence of an opinion expressed by a member of an Aboriginal or Torres Strait Islander group about the existence or non-existence, or the content, of the traditional laws and customs of the group.

heading: Exception—opinions based on specialised knowledge
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.3", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "79", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.3", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "79", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: If a person has specialised knowledge based on the person's training, study or experience, the opinion rule does not apply to evidence of an opinion of that person that is wholly or substantially based on that knowledge.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.3", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "79", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: To avoid doubt, and without limiting subsection (1)—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.3", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "79", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: a reference in that subsection to specialised knowledge includes a reference to specialised knowledge of child development and child behaviour (including specialised knowledge of the impact of sexual abuse on children and their development and behaviour during and following the abuse); and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.3", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "79", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: a reference in that subsection to an opinion of a person includes, if the person has specialised knowledge of the kind referred to in paragraph (a), a reference to an opinion relating to either or both of the following—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.3", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "79", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": "i", "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the development and behaviour of children generally;

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.3", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "79", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": "ii", "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the development and behaviour of children who have been victims of sexual offences, or offences similar to sexual offences.

heading: Ultimate issue and common knowledge rules abolished
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.3", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "80", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Evidence of an opinion is not inadmissible only because it is about—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.3", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "80", "subsection": null, "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: a fact in issue or an ultimate issue; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.3", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "80", "subsection": null, "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: a matter of common knowledge.

heading: Admissions
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.4", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": null, "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.4", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": null, "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Admission is defined in the Dictionary.

heading: Hearsay and opinion rules—exception for admissions and related representations
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.4", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "81", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.4", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "81", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: The hearsay rule and the opinion rule do not apply to evidence of an admission.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.4", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "81", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: The hearsay rule and the opinion rule do not apply to evidence of a previous representation—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.4", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "81", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: that was made in relation to an admission at the time the admission was made, or shortly before or after that time; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.4", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "81", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: to which it is reasonably necessary to refer in order to understand the admission.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.4", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "81", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": "a", "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: that D made the admission to W as proof of the truth of that admission; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.4", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "81", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: D admits to W, his best friend, that he sexually assaulted V. In D's trial for the sexual assault, the prosecution may lead evidence from W—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.4", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "81", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text:
Specific exclusionary rules relating to admissions are as follows—
• evidence of admissions that is not first-hand (section 82)
• use of admissions against third parties (section 83)
• admissions influenced by violence and certain other conduct (section 84)
• unreliable admissions of an accused (section 85)
• records of oral questioning of an accused (section 86)

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.4", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "81", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: that W formed the opinion that D was sane when he made the admission.

heading: Exclusion of evidence of admissions that is not first- hand
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.4", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "82", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Section 81 does not prevent the application of the hearsay rule to evidence of an admission unless—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.4", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "82", "subsection": null, "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: it is given by a person who saw, heard or otherwise perceived the admission being made; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.4", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "82", "subsection": null, "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: it is a document in which the admission is made.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.4", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "82", "subsection": null, "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Section 60 does not apply in a criminal proceeding to evidence of an admission.

heading: Exclusion of evidence of admissions as against third parties
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.4", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "83", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.4", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "83", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Section 81 does not prevent the application of the hearsay rule or the opinion rule to evidence of an admission in respect of the case of a third party.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.4", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "83", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: The evidence may be used in respect of the case of a third party if that party consents.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.4", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "83", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Consent cannot be given in respect of part only of the evidence.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.4", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "83", "subsection": "4", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: In this section, third party means a party to the proceeding concerned, other than the party who—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.4", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "83", "subsection": "4", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: made the admission; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.4", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "83", "subsection": "4", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: adduced the evidence.

heading: Exclusion of admissions influenced by violence and certain other conduct
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.4", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "84", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.4", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "84", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Evidence of an admission is not admissible unless the court is satisfied that the admission, and the making of the admission, were not influenced by—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.4", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "84", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: violent, oppressive, inhuman or degrading conduct, whether towards the person who made the admission or towards another person; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.4", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "84", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: a threat of conduct of that kind.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.4", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "84", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Subsection (1) only applies if the party against whom evidence of the admission is adduced has raised in the proceeding an issue about whether the admission or its making were so influenced.

heading: Criminal proceedings—reliability of admissions by accused
history_json: [{"raw": "S. 85 (Heading) amended by No. 68/2009 s. 97(Sch. item 55.17).", "kind": "amendment", "section": "85", "sub_path": [], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 73, "rect": {"page": 73, "x0": 467.8, "y0": 299.8, "x1": 511.5, "y1": 357.3}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.4", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "85", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

history_json: [{"raw": "S. 85(1) amended by No. 68/2009 s. 97(Sch. item 55.18(a)).", "kind": "amendment", "section": "85", "sub_path": ["(1)"], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 73, "rect": {"page": 73, "x0": 467.8, "y0": 373.0, "x1": 515.8, "y1": 421.2}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.4", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "85", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: This section applies only in a criminal proceeding and only to evidence of an admission made by an accused—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.4", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "85", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: to, or in the presence of, an investigating official who at that time was performing functions in connection with the investigation of the commission, or possible commission, of an offence; or

history_json: [{"raw": "S. 85(1)(b) amended by No. 68/2009 s. 97(Sch. item 55.18(b)).", "kind": "amendment", "section": "85", "sub_path": ["(1)", "(b)"], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 73, "rect": {"page": 73, "x0": 467.8, "y0": 495.4, "x1": 516.3, "y1": 543.6}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.4", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "85", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: as a result of an act of another person who was, and who the accused knew or reasonably believed to be, capable of influencing the decision whether a prosecution of the accused should be brought or should be continued.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.4", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "85", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Subsection (1) was inserted as a response to the decision of the High Court of Australia in Kelly v The Queen (2004) 218 CLR 216.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.4", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "85", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Evidence of the admission is not admissible unless the circumstances in which the admission was made were such as to make it unlikely that the truth of the admission was adversely affected.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.4", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "85", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Without limiting the matters that the court may take into account for the purposes of subsection (2), it is to take into account—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.4", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "85", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: any relevant condition or characteristic of the person who made the admission, including age, personality and education and any mental, intellectual or physical disability to which the person is or appears to be subject; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.4", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "85", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: if the admission was made in response to questioning—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.4", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "85", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": "i", "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the nature of the questions and the manner in which they were put; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.4", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "85", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": "ii", "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the nature of any threat, promise or other inducement made to the person questioned.

heading: Exclusion of records of oral questioning
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.4", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "86", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

history_json: [{"raw": "S. 86(1) amended by No. 68/2009 s. 97(Sch. item 55.19(a)).", "kind": "amendment", "section": "86", "sub_path": ["(1)"], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 74, "rect": {"page": 74, "x0": 79.3, "y0": 428.2, "x1": 127.4, "y1": 476.4}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.4", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "86", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: This section applies only in a criminal proceeding and only if an oral admission was made by an accused to an investigating official in response to a question put or a representation made by the official.

history_json: [{"raw": "S. 86(2) amended by No. 68/2009 s. 97(Sch. item 55.19(b)).", "kind": "amendment", "section": "86", "sub_path": ["(2)"], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 74, "rect": {"page": 74, "x0": 79.3, "y0": 503.2, "x1": 127.9, "y1": 551.4}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.4", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "86", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: A document prepared by or on behalf of the official is not admissible to prove the contents of the question, representation or response unless the accused has acknowledged that the document is a true record of the question, representation or response.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.4", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "86", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: The acknowledgement must be made by signing, initialling or otherwise marking the document.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.4", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "86", "subsection": "4", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: In this section, document does not include—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.4", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "86", "subsection": "4", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: a sound recording, or a transcript of a sound recording; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.4", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "86", "subsection": "4", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: a recording of visual images and sounds, or a transcript of the sounds so recorded.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.4", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "86", "subsection": "4", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: See also sections 83 and 84 of the Criminal Procedure Act 2009 which relate to the admissibility of evidence in the absence of an accused in a summary hearing.

heading: Admissions made with authority
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.4", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "87", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.4", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "87", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: For the purpose of determining whether a previous representation made by a person is also taken to be an admission by a party, the court is to admit the representation if it is reasonably open to find that—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.4", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "87", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: when the representation was made, the person had authority to make statements on behalf of the party in relation to the matter with respect to which the representation was made; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.4", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "87", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: when the representation was made, the person was an employee of the party, or had authority otherwise to act for the party, and the representation related to a matter within the scope of the person's employment or authority; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.4", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "87", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "c", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the representation was made by the person in furtherance of a common purpose (whether lawful or not) that the person had with the party or one or more persons including the party.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.4", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "87", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: For the purposes of this section, the hearsay rule does not apply to a previous representation made by a person that tends to prove—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.4", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "87", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: that the person had authority to make statements on behalf of another person in relation to a matter; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.4", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "87", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: that the person was an employee of another person or had authority otherwise to act for another person; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.4", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "87", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "c", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the scope of the person's employment or authority.

heading: Proof of admissions
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.4", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "88", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: For the purpose of determining whether evidence of an admission is admissible, the court is to find that a particular person made the admission if it is reasonably open to find that he or she made the admission.

heading: Evidence of silence
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.4", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "89", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.4", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "89", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: In a criminal proceeding, an inference unfavourable to a party must not be drawn from evidence that the party or another person failed or refused—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.4", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "89", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: to answer one or more questions; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.4", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "89", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: to respond to a representation—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.4", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "89", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: put or made to the party or other person by an investigating official who at that time was performing functions in connection with the investigation of the commission, or possible commission, of an offence.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.4", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "89", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Evidence of that kind is not admissible if it can only be used to draw such an inference.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.4", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "89", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Subsection (1) does not prevent use of the evidence to prove that the party or other person failed or refused to answer the question or to respond to the representation if the failure or refusal is a fact in issue in the proceeding.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.4", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "89", "subsection": "4", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: In this section, inference includes—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.4", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "89", "subsection": "4", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: an inference of consciousness of guilt; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.4", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "89", "subsection": "4", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: an inference relevant to a party's credibility.

heading: Discretion to exclude admissions
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.4", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "90", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: In a criminal proceeding, the court may refuse to admit evidence of an admission, or refuse to admit the evidence to prove a particular fact, if—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.4", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "90", "subsection": null, "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the evidence is adduced by the prosecution; and

history_json: [{"raw": "S. 90(b) amended by No. 68/2009 s. 97(Sch. item 55.20).", "kind": "amendment", "section": "90", "sub_path": ["(b)"], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 77, "rect": {"page": 77, "x0": 467.8, "y0": 317.8, "x1": 511.5, "y1": 366.0}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.4", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "90", "subsection": null, "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: having regard to the circumstances in which the admission was made, it would be unfair to an accused to use the evidence.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.4", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "90", "subsection": null, "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Part 3.11 contains other exclusionary discretions that are applicable to admissions.

heading: Evidence of judgments and convictions
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.5", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": null, "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

heading: Exclusion of evidence of judgments and convictions
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.5", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "91", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.5", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "91", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Evidence of the decision, or of a finding of fact, in an Australian or overseas proceeding is not admissible to prove the existence of a fact that was in issue in that proceeding.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.5", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "91", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Evidence that, under this Part, is not admissible to prove the existence of a fact may not be used to prove that fact even if it is relevant for another purpose.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.5", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "91", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Section 178 (Convictions, acquittals and other judicial proceedings) provides for certificate evidence of decisions.

heading: Exceptions
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.5", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "92", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.5", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "92", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Section 91(1) does not prevent the admission or use of evidence of the grant of probate, letters of administration or a similar order of a court to prove—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.5", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "92", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the death, or date of death, of a person; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.5", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "92", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the due execution of a testamentary document.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.5", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "92", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: In a civil proceeding, section 91(1) does not prevent the admission or use of evidence that a party, or a person through or under whom a party claims, has been convicted of an offence, not being a conviction—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.5", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "92", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: in respect of which a review or appeal (however described) has been instituted but not finally determined; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.5", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "92", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: that has been quashed or set aside; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.5", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "92", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "c", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: in respect of which a pardon has been given.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.5", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "92", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: The hearsay rule and the opinion rule do not apply to evidence of a kind referred to in this section.

heading: Savings
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.5", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "93", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: This Part does not affect the operation of—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.5", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "93", "subsection": null, "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: a law that relates to the admissibility or effect of evidence of a conviction tendered in a proceeding (including a criminal proceeding) for defamation; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.5", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "93", "subsection": null, "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: a judgment in rem; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.5", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "93", "subsection": null, "paragraph": "c", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the law relating to res judicata or issue estoppel.

heading: Tendency and coincidence
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.6", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": null, "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

history_json: [{"raw": "Note to Pt 3.6 (Heading) inserted by No. 14/2015 s. 71.", "kind": "amendment", "section": null, "sub_path": [], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 80, "rect": {"page": 80, "x0": 79.3, "y0": 187.9, "x1": 125.7, "y1": 236.3}, "confidence": "manual", "linked_at": "2026-09-29T11:16:55.816579+00:00"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.6", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": null, "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: See also Division 2 of Part 4 of the Jury Directions Act 2015.

heading: Court may dispense with notice requirements
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.6", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "100", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.6", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "100", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: The court may, on the application of a party, direct that the tendency rule is not to apply to particular tendency evidence despite the party's failure to give notice under section 97.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.6", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "100", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: The court may, on the application of a party, direct that the coincidence rule is not to apply to particular coincidence evidence despite the party's failure to give notice under section 98.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.6", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "100", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: The application may be made either before or after the time by which the party would, apart from this section, be required to give, or to have given, the notice.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.6", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "100", "subsection": "4", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: In a civil proceeding, the party's application may be made without notice of it having been given to one or more of the other parties.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.6", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "100", "subsection": "5", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: The direction—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.6", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "100", "subsection": "5", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: is subject to such conditions (if any) as the court thinks fit; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.6", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "100", "subsection": "5", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: may be given either at or before the hearing.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.6", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "100", "subsection": "6", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Without limiting the court's power to impose conditions under this section, those conditions may include one or more of the following—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.6", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "100", "subsection": "6", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: a condition that the party give notice of its intention to adduce the evidence to a specified party, or to each other party other than a specified party;

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.6", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "100", "subsection": "6", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: a condition that the party give such notice only in respect of specified tendency evidence, or all tendency evidence that the party intends to adduce other than specified tendency evidence;

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.6", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "100", "subsection": "6", "paragraph": "c", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: a condition that the party give such notice only in respect of specified coincidence evidence, or all coincidence evidence that the party intends to adduce other than specified coincidence evidence.

heading: Further restrictions on tendency evidence and coincidence evidence adduced by prosecution
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.6", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "101", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.6", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "101", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: This section only applies in a criminal proceeding and so applies in addition to sections 97 and 98.

history_json: [{"raw": "S. 101(2) amended by No. 68/2009 s. 97(Sch. item 55.21).", "kind": "amendment", "section": "101", "sub_path": ["(2)"], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 84, "rect": {"page": 84, "x0": 79.3, "y0": 299.8, "x1": 123.1, "y1": 348.0}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.6", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "101", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Tendency evidence about an accused, or coincidence evidence about an accused, that is adduced by the prosecution cannot be used against the accused unless the probative value of the evidence substantially outweighs any prejudicial effect it may have on the accused.

history_json: [{"raw": "S. 101(3) amended by No. 68/2009 s. 97(Sch. item 55.21(b)).", "kind": "amendment", "section": "101", "sub_path": ["(3)"], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 84, "rect": {"page": 84, "x0": 79.3, "y0": 388.6, "x1": 127.9, "y1": 436.8}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.6", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "101", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: This section does not apply to tendency evidence that the prosecution adduces to explain or contradict tendency evidence adduced by the accused.

history_json: [{"raw": "S. 101(4) amended by No. 68/2009 s. 97(Sch. item 55.21(b)).", "kind": "amendment", "section": "101", "sub_path": ["(4)"], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 84, "rect": {"page": 84, "x0": 79.3, "y0": 449.8, "x1": 127.9, "y1": 498.0}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.6", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "101", "subsection": "4", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: This section does not apply to coincidence evidence that the prosecution adduces to explain or contradict coincidence evidence adduced by the accused.

heading: Application
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.6", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "94", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.6", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "94", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: This Part does not apply to evidence that relates only to the credibility of a witness.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.6", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "94", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: This Part does not apply so far as a proceeding relates to bail or sentencing.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.6", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "94", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: This Part does not apply to evidence of—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.6", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "94", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the character, reputation or conduct of a person; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.6", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "94", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: a tendency that a person has or had—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.6", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "94", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: if that character, reputation, conduct or tendency is a fact in issue.

heading: Use of evidence for other purposes
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.6", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "95", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.6", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "95", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Evidence that under this Part is not admissible to prove a particular matter must not be used to prove that matter even if it is relevant for another purpose.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.6", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "95", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Evidence that under this Part cannot be used against a party to prove a particular matter must not be used against the party to prove that matter even if it is relevant for another purpose.

heading: Failure to act
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.6", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "96", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: A reference in this Part to doing an act includes a reference to failing to do that act.

heading: The tendency rule
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.6", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "97", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.6", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "97", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Evidence of the character, reputation or conduct of a person, or a tendency that a person has or had, is not admissible to prove that a person has or had a tendency (whether because of the person's character or otherwise) to act in a particular way, or to have a particular state of mind unless—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.6", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "97", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the party seeking to adduce the evidence gave reasonable notice in writing to each other party of the party's intention to adduce the evidence; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.6", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "97", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the court thinks that the evidence will, either by itself or having regard to other evidence adduced or to be adduced by the party seeking to adduce the evidence, have significant probative value.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.6", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "97", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Subsection (1)(a) does not apply if—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.6", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "97", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the evidence is adduced in accordance with any directions made by the court under section 100; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.6", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "97", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the evidence is adduced to explain or contradict tendency evidence adduced by another party.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.6", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "97", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: The tendency rule is subject to specific exceptions concerning character of and expert opinion about an accused (sections 110 and 111). Other provisions of this Act, or of other laws, may operate as further exceptions.

heading: The coincidence rule
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.6", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "98", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.6", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "98", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Evidence that 2 or more events occurred is not admissible to prove that a person did a particular act or had a particular state of mind on the basis that, having regard to any similarities in the events or the circumstances in which they occurred, or any similarities in both the events and the circumstances in which they occurred, it is improbable that the events occurred coincidentally unless—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.6", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "98", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the party seeking to adduce the evidence gave reasonable notice in writing to each other party of the party's intention to adduce the evidence; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.6", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "98", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the court thinks that the evidence will, either by itself or having regard to other evidence adduced or to be adduced by the party seeking to adduce the evidence, have significant probative value.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.6", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "98", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: One of the events referred to in subsection (1) may be an event the occurrence of which is a fact in issue in the proceeding.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.6", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "98", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Subsection (1)(a) does not apply if—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.6", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "98", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the evidence is adduced in accordance with any directions made by the court under section 100; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.6", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "98", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the evidence is adduced to explain or contradict coincidence evidence adduced by another party.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.6", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "98", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Other provisions of this Act, or of other laws, may operate as exceptions to the coincidence rule.

heading: Requirements for notices
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.6", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "99", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Notices given under section 97 or 98 are to be given in accordance with any regulations or rules of court made for the purposes of this section.

heading: Credibility
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.7", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": null, "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

heading: Credibility evidence
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.7", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": null, "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

heading: Credibility evidence
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.7", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "101A", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Credibility evidence, in relation to a witness or other person, is evidence relevant to the credibility of the witness or person that—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.7", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "101A", "subsection": null, "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: is relevant only because it affects the assessment of the credibility of the witness or person; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.7", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "101A", "subsection": null, "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: is relevant—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.7", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "101A", "subsection": null, "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": "i", "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: because it affects the assessment of the credibility of the witness or person; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.7", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "101A", "subsection": null, "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": "ii", "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: for some other purpose for which it is not admissible, or cannot be used, because of a provision of Parts 3.2 to 3.6.
