path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.7", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "101A", "subsection": null, "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": "ii", "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Sections 60 and 77 will not affect the application of paragraph (b), because they cannot apply to evidence that is yet to be admitted.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.7", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "101A", "subsection": null, "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": "ii", "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Section 101A was inserted as a response to the decision of the High Court of Australia in Adam v The Queen (2001) 207 CLR 96.

heading: Credibility of witnesses
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.7", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": null, "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

heading: The credibility rule
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.7", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "102", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Credibility evidence about a witness is not admissible.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.7", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "102", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text:
Specific exceptions to the credibility rule are as follows—
• evidence adduced in cross-examination (sections 103 and 104)
• evidence in rebuttal of denials (section 106)
• evidence to re-establish credibility (section 108)
• evidence of persons with specialised knowledge (section 108C)
• character of accused persons (section 110) Other provisions of this Act, or of other laws, may operate as further exceptions.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.7", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "102", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Sections 108A and 108B deal with the admission of credibility evidence about a person who has made a previous representation but is not a witness.

heading: Exception—cross-examination as to credibility
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.7", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "103", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.7", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "103", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: The credibility rule does not apply to evidence adduced in cross-examination of a witness if the evidence could substantially affect the assessment of the credibility of the witness.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.7", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "103", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Without limiting the matters to which the court may have regard for the purposes of subsection (1), it is to have regard to—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.7", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "103", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: whether the evidence tends to prove that the witness knowingly or recklessly made a false representation when the witness was under an obligation to tell the truth; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.7", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "103", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the period that has elapsed since the acts or events to which the evidence relates were done or occurred.

heading: Further protections—cross-examination as to credibility
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.7", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "104", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.7", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "104", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: This section applies only to credibility evidence in a criminal proceeding and so applies in addition to section 103.

history_json: [{"raw": "S. 104(2) amended by No. 68/2009 s. 97(Sch. item 55.22).", "kind": "amendment", "section": "104", "sub_path": ["(2)"], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 86, "rect": {"page": 86, "x0": 79.3, "y0": 611.3, "x1": 123.1, "y1": 659.7}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.7", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "104", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: An accused must not be cross-examined about a matter that is relevant to the assessment of the credibility of the accused, unless the court gives leave.

history_json: [{"raw": "S. 104(3) amended by No. 68/2009 s. 97(Sch. item 55.23).", "kind": "amendment", "section": "104", "sub_path": ["(3)"], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 87, "rect": {"page": 87, "x0": 467.8, "y0": 163.6, "x1": 511.5, "y1": 211.9}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.7", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "104", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Despite subsection (2), leave is not required for cross-examination by the prosecutor about whether the accused—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.7", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "104", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: is biased or has a motive to be untruthful; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.7", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "104", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: is, or was, unable to be aware of or recall matters to which his or her evidence relates; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.7", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "104", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": "c", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: has made a prior inconsistent statement.

history_json: [{"raw": "S. 104(4) amended by No. 68/2009 s. 97(Sch. item 55.23).", "kind": "amendment", "section": "104", "sub_path": ["(4)"], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 87, "rect": {"page": 87, "x0": 467.8, "y0": 292.0, "x1": 511.5, "y1": 340.2}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.7", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "104", "subsection": "4", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Leave must not be given for cross-examination by the prosecutor under subsection (2) unless evidence adduced by the accused has been admitted that—

text: tends to prove that a witness called by the prosecutor has a tendency to be untruthful; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.7", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "104", "subsection": "4", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: is relevant solely or mainly to the witness's credibility.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.7", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "104", "subsection": "5", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: A reference in subsection (4) to evidence does not include a reference to evidence of conduct in relation to—

history_json: [{"raw": "S. 104(5)(a) amended by No. 68/2009 s. 97(Sch. item 55.24).", "kind": "amendment", "section": "104", "sub_path": ["(5)", "(a)"], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 87, "rect": {"page": 87, "x0": 467.8, "y0": 481.6, "x1": 511.5, "y1": 529.8}, "confidence": "high"}]

text: the events in relation to which the accused is being prosecuted; or

history_json: [{"raw": "S. 104(5)(b) amended by No. 68/2009 s. 97(Sch. item 55.24).", "kind": "amendment", "section": "104", "sub_path": ["(5)", "(b)"], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 87, "rect": {"page": 87, "x0": 467.8, "y0": 535.0, "x1": 511.5, "y1": 583.2}, "confidence": "high"}]

history_json: [{"raw": "S. 104(6) amended by No. 68/2009 s. 97(Sch. item 55.25).", "kind": "amendment", "section": "104", "sub_path": ["(6)"], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 88, "rect": {"page": 88, "x0": 79.3, "y0": 163.6, "x1": 123.1, "y1": 211.9}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.7", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "104", "subsection": "6", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Leave is not to be given for cross-examination by another accused unless—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.7", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "104", "subsection": "6", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

text: that evidence has been admitted.

heading: Further protections—accused making unsworn statements
history_json: [{"raw": "S. 105 (Heading) amended by No. 68/2009 s. 97(Sch. item 55.26).", "kind": "amendment", "section": "105", "sub_path": [], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 88, "rect": {"page": 88, "x0": 79.3, "y0": 311.8, "x1": 123.1, "y1": 369.3}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.7", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "105", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.7", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "105", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.7", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "105", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

heading: Exception—rebutting denials by other evidence
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.7", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "106", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.7", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "106", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: The credibility rule does not apply to evidence that is relevant to a witness's credibility and that is adduced otherwise than from the witness if—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.7", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "106", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: in cross-examination of the witness—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.7", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "106", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": "i", "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the substance of the evidence was put to the witness; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.7", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "106", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": "ii", "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the witness denied, or did not admit or agree to, the substance of the evidence; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.7", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "106", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the court gives leave to adduce the evidence.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.7", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "106", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Leave under subsection (1)(b) is not required if the evidence tends to prove that the witness—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.7", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "106", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: is biased or has a motive for being untruthful; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.7", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "106", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: has been convicted of an offence, including an offence against the law of a foreign country; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.7", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "106", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "c", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: has made a prior inconsistent statement; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.7", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "106", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "d", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: is, or was, unable to be aware of matters to which his or her evidence relates; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.7", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "106", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "e", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: has knowingly or recklessly made a false representation while under an obligation, imposed by or under an Australian law or a law of a foreign country, to tell the truth.

heading: Exception—application of certain provisions to makers of representations
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.7", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "107", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.7", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "107", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: This section has been repealed from the Commonwealth Act and New South Wales Act.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.7", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "107", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

heading: Exception—re-establishing credibility
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.7", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "108", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.7", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "108", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: The credibility rule does not apply to evidence adduced in re-examination of a witness.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.7", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "108", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.7", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "108", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: The Commonwealth Act previously included a subsection referring to section 105 of that Act.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.7", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "108", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.7", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "108", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: The credibility rule does not apply to evidence of a prior consistent statement of a witness if—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.7", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "108", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: evidence of a prior inconsistent statement of the witness has been admitted; or

text: it is or will be suggested (either expressly or by implication) that evidence given by the witness has been fabricated or re-constructed (whether deliberately or otherwise) or is the result of a suggestion—

text: If—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.7", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": "108A", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.7", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": "108A", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the period that elapsed between the doing of the acts or the occurrence of the events to which the representation related and the making of the representation.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.7", "division": "4", "subdivision": null, "section": "108C", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.9", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "114", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: it would not have been reasonable to have held such a parade; or

history_json: [{"raw": "S. 114(2)(c) amended by No. 68/2009 s. 97(Sch. item 55.32).", "kind": "amendment", "section": "114", "sub_path": ["(2)", "(c)"], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 96, "rect": {"page": 96, "x0": 79.3, "y0": 505.6, "x1": 123.1, "y1": 553.8}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.9", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "114", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "c", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the accused refused to take part in such a parade—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.9", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "114", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: and the identification was made without the person who made it having been intentionally influenced to identify the accused.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.9", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "114", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Without limiting the matters that may be taken into account by the court in determining whether it was reasonable to hold an identification parade, it is to take into account—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.9", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "114", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the kind of offence, and the gravity of the offence, concerned; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.9", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "114", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the importance of the evidence; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.9", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "114", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": "c", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the practicality of holding an identification parade having regard, among other things—

history_json: [{"raw": "S. 114(3)(c)(i) amended by No. 68/2009 s. 97(Sch. item 55.32).", "kind": "amendment", "section": "114", "sub_path": ["(3)", "(c)", "(i)"], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 97, "rect": {"page": 97, "x0": 467.8, "y0": 305.8, "x1": 512.8, "y1": 354.0}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.9", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "114", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": "c", "subparagraph": "i", "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: if the accused failed to cooperate in the conduct of the parade—to the manner and extent of, and the reason (if any) for, the failure; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.9", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "114", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": "c", "subparagraph": "ii", "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: in any case—to whether the identification was made at or about the time of the commission of the offence; and

history_json: [{"raw": "S. 114(3)(d) amended by No. 68/2009 s. 97(Sch. item 55.32).", "kind": "amendment", "section": "114", "sub_path": ["(3)", "(d)"], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 97, "rect": {"page": 97, "x0": 467.8, "y0": 428.2, "x1": 511.5, "y1": 476.4}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.9", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "114", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": "d", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the appropriateness of holding an identification parade having regard, among other things, to the relationship (if any) between the accused and the person who made the identification.

history_json: [{"raw": "S. 114(4) amended by No. 68/2009 s. 97(Sch. item 55.32).", "kind": "amendment", "section": "114", "sub_path": ["(4)"], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 97, "rect": {"page": 97, "x0": 467.8, "y0": 503.2, "x1": 511.5, "y1": 551.4}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.9", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "114", "subsection": "4", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: It is presumed that it would not have been reasonable to have held an identification parade if it would have been unfair to the accused for such a parade to have been held.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.9", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "114", "subsection": "5", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: If—

history_json: [{"raw": "S. 114(5)(a) amended by Nos 68/2009 s. 97(Sch. item 55.32), 17/2014 s. 160(Sch. 2 item 39.3).", "kind": "amendment", "section": "114", "sub_path": ["(5)", "(a)"], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 97, "rect": {"page": 97, "x0": 467.8, "y0": 584.2, "x1": 512.0, "y1": 660.0}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.9", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "114", "subsection": "5", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the accused refused to take part in an identification parade unless an Australian legal practitioner acting for the accused, or another person chosen by the accused, was present while it was being held; and

history_json: [{"raw": "S. 114(5)(b) amended by No. 17/2014 s. 160(Sch. 2 item 39.3).", "kind": "amendment", "section": "114", "sub_path": ["(5)", "(b)"], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 98, "rect": {"page": 98, "x0": 79.3, "y0": 163.6, "x1": 123.6, "y1": 211.9}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.9", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "114", "subsection": "5", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: there were, at the time when the parade was to have been conducted, reasonable grounds to believe that it was not reasonably practicable for such an Australian legal practitioner or person to be present—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.9", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "114", "subsection": "5", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: it is presumed that it would not have been reasonable to have held an identification parade at that time.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.9", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "114", "subsection": "6", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: In determining whether it was reasonable to have held an identification parade, the court is not to take into account the availability of pictures or photographs that could be used in making identifications.

heading: Exclusion of evidence of identification by pictures
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.9", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "115", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.9", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "115", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: In this section, picture identification evidence means identification evidence relating to an identification made wholly or partly by the person who made the identification examining pictures kept for the use of police officers.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.9", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "115", "subsection": "10", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: In this section—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.9", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "115", "subsection": "10", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: a reference to a picture includes a reference to a photograph; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.9", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "115", "subsection": "10", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: a reference to making a picture includes a reference to taking a photograph.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.9", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "115", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Picture identification evidence adduced by the prosecutor is not admissible if the pictures examined suggest that they are pictures of persons in police custody.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.9", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "115", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Subject to subsection (4), picture identification evidence adduced by the prosecutor is not admissible if—

history_json: [{"raw": "S. 115(3)(a) amended by No. 68/2009 s. 97(Sch. item 55.33(a)).", "kind": "amendment", "section": "115", "sub_path": ["(3)", "(a)"], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 98, "rect": {"page": 98, "x0": 79.3, "y0": 558.4, "x1": 127.4, "y1": 606.6}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.9", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "115", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: when the pictures were examined, the accused was in the custody of a police officer of the police force investigating the commission of the offence with which the accused has been charged; and

history_json: [{"raw": "S. 115(3)(b) amended by No. 68/2009 s. 97(Sch. item 55.33(a)).", "kind": "amendment", "section": "115", "sub_path": ["(3)", "(b)"], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 98, "rect": {"page": 98, "x0": 79.3, "y0": 633.4, "x1": 127.4, "y1": 681.6}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.9", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "115", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the picture of the accused that was examined was made before the accused was taken into that police custody.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.9", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "115", "subsection": "4", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Subsection (3) does not apply if—

history_json: [{"raw": "S. 115(4)(a) amended by No. 68/2009 s. 97(Sch. item 55.33).", "kind": "amendment", "section": "115", "sub_path": ["(4)", "(a)"], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 99, "rect": {"page": 99, "x0": 467.8, "y0": 177.4, "x1": 511.5, "y1": 225.7}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.9", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "115", "subsection": "4", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.9", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "115", "subsection": "4", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: it was not reasonably practicable to make a picture of the accused after the accused was taken into that custody.

history_json: [{"raw": "S. 115(5) amended by No. 68/2009 s. 97(Sch. item 55.33(a)).", "kind": "amendment", "section": "115", "sub_path": ["(5)"], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 99, "rect": {"page": 99, "x0": 467.8, "y0": 305.8, "x1": 515.8, "y1": 354.0}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.9", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "115", "subsection": "5", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

history_json: [{"raw": "S. 115(5)(b) amended by No. 68/2009 s. 97(Sch. item 55.33).", "kind": "amendment", "section": "115", "sub_path": ["(5)", "(b)"], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 99, "rect": {"page": 99, "x0": 467.8, "y0": 448.0, "x1": 511.5, "y1": 496.2}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.9", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "115", "subsection": "5", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the appearance of the accused had changed significantly between the time when the offence was committed and the time when the accused was taken into that custody; or

history_json: [{"raw": "S. 115(5)(c) amended by No. 68/2009 s. 97(Sch. item 55.33(a)).", "kind": "amendment", "section": "115", "sub_path": ["(5)", "(c)"], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 99, "rect": {"page": 99, "x0": 467.8, "y0": 509.2, "x1": 515.8, "y1": 557.4}, "confidence": "high"}]

text: it would not have been reasonable to have held an identification parade that included the accused.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.9", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "115", "subsection": "6", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Sections 114(3), (4), (5) and (6) apply in determining, for the purposes of subsection (5)(c) of this section, whether it would have been reasonable to have held an identification parade.

history_json: [{"raw": "S. 115(7) amended by No. 68/2009 s. 97(Sch. item 55.33(a)).", "kind": "amendment", "section": "115", "sub_path": ["(7)"], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 99, "rect": {"page": 99, "x0": 467.8, "y0": 637.6, "x1": 515.8, "y1": 685.8}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.9", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "115", "subsection": "7", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: If picture identification evidence adduced by the prosecutor is admitted into evidence, the judge must, on the request of the accused—

history_json: [{"raw": "S. 115(7)(a) amended by No. 68/2009 s. 97(Sch. item 55.33(a)).", "kind": "amendment", "section": "115", "sub_path": ["(7)", "(a)"], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 100, "rect": {"page": 100, "x0": 79.3, "y0": 163.6, "x1": 127.4, "y1": 211.9}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.9", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "115", "subsection": "7", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: if the picture of the accused was made after the accused was taken into that custody— inform the jury that the picture was made after the accused was taken into that custody; or

history_json: [{"raw": "S. 115(7)(b) amended by No. 68/2009 s. 97(Sch. item 55.33(a)).", "kind": "amendment", "section": "115", "sub_path": ["(7)", "(b)"], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 100, "rect": {"page": 100, "x0": 79.3, "y0": 232.6, "x1": 127.4, "y1": 280.9}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.9", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "115", "subsection": "7", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: otherwise—warn the jury that they must not assume that the accused has a criminal record or has previously been charged with an offence.

history_json: [{"raw": "Note to s. 115(7) substituted by No. 14/2015 s. 72.", "kind": "amendment", "section": "115", "sub_path": ["(7)"], "target_kind": "note", "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 100, "rect": {"page": 100, "x0": 79.3, "y0": 293.8, "x1": 129.1, "y1": 342.0}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.9", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "115", "subsection": "7", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Division 4 of Part 4 of the Jury Directions Act 2015 also deals with warnings about identification evidence.

history_json: [{"raw": "S. 115(8) amended by No. 68/2009 s. 97(Sch. item 55.33(a)).", "kind": "amendment", "section": "115", "sub_path": ["(8)"], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 100, "rect": {"page": 100, "x0": 79.3, "y0": 360.0, "x1": 127.4, "y1": 408.4}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.9", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "115", "subsection": "8", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: This section does not render inadmissible picture identification evidence adduced by the prosecutor that contradicts or qualifies picture identification evidence adduced by the accused.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.9", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "115", "subsection": "9", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: This section applies in addition to section 114.
